THE OPERATIONAL DISCONNECT

Five Disconnected Silos. One Fragile Project.

In industrial warehouse manufacturing and engineering, critical context is fractured across independent tools. When systems cannot converse, coordination breaks down, schedules slip, and visibility is delayed.

01 / SYSTEMS

Fragmented Systems

ERP financials, 3D BIM models, cut lists, and shop schedules remain trapped in isolated silos with zero semantic bridge.

02 / INBOXES

Disconnected Data

Urgent revision notices, engineering clarifications, and customer directives remain buried in unsearchable email threads.

03 / OVERHEAD

Manual Coordination

Project managers spend up to 40% of their day manually calling plant supervisors to verify basic part quantities and drawings.

04 / DELAY

Delayed Visibility

Material shortages, roll-forming bottlenecks, and weld holds are frequently discovered only when the dispatch truck arrives.

05 / TELEMETRY

Trapped Machine Data

Cold roll-forming lines and punch presses generate thousands of telemetry data points daily that never inform project schedules.

Adding another database does not solve this. ProRack AI sits above your stack to interpret and connect your existing systems of record.
